verified.exploit_entry_point: file.Store.Push with a caller-supplied AnnotationTitle and AnnotationUnpack=true (pushDir -> extractTarGzip -> extractTarDirectory).
sites: content/file/utils.go:264-275 (ensureLinkPath validates a joined, cleaned path but returns the literal target)
content/file/utils.go:231-259 (resolveRelToBase compares strings and Lstats only parent components)
routes: a layer whose relative link targets lexically stay inside the layer but whose kernel-resolved target is outside it, followed by a same-named regular member
verified.project_tests_run: At the pinned commit the environment image builds with `go build ./...` and runs the project's own `go test ./content/file` (all pass). The control reference keeps that package green.

traps.shape: a relative link target whose lexically cleaned form stays in the layer while one component in the literal target is itself a previously extracted link; a regular member with the same name then writes through it
traps.reason_to_dismiss: ensureLinkPath already validates every link target against the layer dir, and a target whose lexical clean is the layer dir itself is indistinguishable from '.', so the target reads as contained and the check as complete.
traps.realistic_because: the reported route: an ordinary untrusted layer passed to the public Store.Push entry point with unpacking enabled
